denominator: Share of Iran crude-oil and condensate exports ultimately destined for China
notes: EIA reports nearly 90%; Iran's total crude-oil and condensate exports were nearly 1.4 million b/d. Destinations listed as unknown or via third countries were assessed as China-bound.

denominator: Share of Iran's shipped oil bought by China; comparison share is Iranian oil in China's seaborne oil imports
notes: Reuters reports Kpler's estimate as more than 80%; 1.38 million b/d represented 13.4% of China's 10.27 million b/d seaborne imports.

denominator: Share of Iran oil exports purchased by China
notes: Treasury states approximately 90% and identifies independent teapot refineries as the majority buyers. Treat as an official sanctions-policy estimate, not a neutral customs statistic.
